blocks.text: The Bureau of Immigration deports 139 Indonesian nationals on Tuesday, November 24 over immigration violations and security threats. (Photo courtesy of BI) MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Immigration deported a total of 139 Indonesian nationals on Tuesday “for posing threats to national security and public interest.” “The deportees, who were previously under Philippine National Police (PNP) custody, were identified as fugitives by Indonesian authorities and subsequently classified as undesirable aliens under Philippine immigration laws for posing threats to national security and public interest,” the BI said in a statement.
